shipped_rows.title_o: On Positive Psychological Outcomes: What Helps Groups With a History of Conflict to Forgive and Reconcile With Each Other?

blind_target.authors: Noor, M., R. Brown, and G. Prentice.
blind_target.title: Precursors and Mediators of Intergroup Reconciliation in Northern Ireland: A New Model.
blind_target.evidence_quote:
This article aims to replicate, refine and extend the Rec-
onciliation Orientation Model (ROM; Noor et al. 2008a), which
examines key intergroup conflict factors – such as competitive
victimhood, ingroup identity and forgiveness.
blind_target.outcome_quote:
These findings replicate the results reported by the original test
of ROM (Noor et al. 2008a) and related literature (Uluğ et al.
2021).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly confirm the original ROM findings. Multidimensional identity and conflict-type findings extend the model. Other cited studies supply related literature or measures rather than distinct findings this paper expressly re-tests.
